export_evidence: No export shipment found. ImportKey page for slug 'ir-innovate-research-private-limited' reports 'Total Shipments 35 Records detected' / 'Latest Cargo 2025-12-10', but every row runs INBOUND into India, e.g. '2025-12-10 | IR INNOVATE RESEARCH PRIVATE LIMITED | DAIICHI SANKYO EUROPE GMBH | HUMAN PLASMA SAMPLES (400 VIALS- 1 ML EACH) - FOR TESTING PURPOSE ONLY | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC, India | FRANKFURTMAIN INTL, GERMANY | 30029010 | 7764166' — i.e. the company is the Indian consignee, Germany is origin. Same pattern for B/L 2398526 (2025-06-03, BOCA BIOLISTICS, Miami FL, US, HS 30029010), B/L 9023201 and 8842395 (2025-03-15 / 2025-03-08, SANOFI PASTEUR VAXDESIGN, Los Angeles, US, HS 30029010). The second slug 'ir-innovate-research-pvt-ltd' renders the same dataset explicitly labelled 'India import data refreshed daily' with no export rows. Source counter: page claims 35 shipments; only 5 individual rows were visible in the free view (rows seen = 5 of 35 claimed). No outbound bill of lading, no export destination, no export HS line was observed.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. Registry/aggregator pages returned HTTP 403 (zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com) or 404 (instafinancials.com), and the search backend was unavailable ('searx: Connection refused'), so no domestic supply record was seen either way. Not public in the sources reachable — recorded as null, not inferred.
note: Declared HS 300290 is consistent with what the customs rows actually show (30029010 / 30021290), so no HS correction is needed. However, the direction is the opposite of a supplier: the 35 customs records are imports of human plasma, whole blood, nostril swab and urine samples 'FOR TESTING PURPOSE ONLY' arriving at Delhi Air Cargo ACC from Daiichi Sankyo Europe, Boca Biolistics, Sanofi Pasteur VaxDesign and Medibiolab. This is the profile of a clinical-trial / bio-sample handling CRO, not an exporter of goods. No traces of supply shipments were found on either the export side or the domestic side — stated plainly: следов поставок не найдено. The company is not rejected (it exists and is active in customs data as recently as 2025-12-10); it is simply not evidenced as a supplier. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in reachable sources). Note the free view exposed only 5 of the 35 claimed rows, so the remaining 30 were not individually inspected.
